paṭi, pati ind. [ S. prati], prefix to nouns and adjectives; preverb to verbs (often in combination with other preverbs); postposition; before vowels (other than i, ī) generally taking the form pacc-; Abh 1178; Sadd 616, 24 foll. (atipatitīnaṃ ti caṃ: atipati-itisaddānaṃ tikāro sare pare kvaci cakāraṃ pappoti … paccakkhaṃ … kvacī ti kiṃ … paṭi-uttarati); 628, 20 foll. (kvaci sare vyañjane vā paṭi patissa: pati icc etassa sare vā vyañjane vā pare kvaci paṭi-ādeso hoti); 715, 25 foll.; 881, 12 foll. (patisaddo paṭigate …); — 1. as prefix to nouns and adjectives expresses : ( i ) counter; corresponding; a false …; Tikap-a 232, 3 (paṭī ti sadisatthe vattati, sadisapuggalo hi paṭipuggalo sadisabhāgo ca paṭibhāgo ti vuccati); — ( ii ) used distributively expresses: at every, on every; severally; Ud-a 224, 33 (pati mokkho ti vā patimokkho … paccekaṃ mokkho ti attho); It-a II 89, 35 (ānāpāne paṭissato ti ānāpānanimittasmiṃ paṭi paṭi sato); Ap-a 568, 32 (pati ekaṃ visuṃ); Cp-a 234, 14 (pāde pakkhe ca paṭi visuṃ īhāmi); — ( iii ) in avyavyībhāva compounds expresses : towards; facing; against; Sadd 747, 31 (paṭi iti ayaṃ upasaggo nivattanatthe vattati evaṃ paṭipathaṃ paṭisotaṃ); 778, 9 (abhi pati icc etesam ābhimukhye aggiṃ abhimukhā salabhā patanti abbhaggi paccaggi icc ādi); — 2. as preverb to verbs and their derivatives expresses: towards; against; back, again, in return;
